note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962 UBS wording the first edition carried. The English Real Questions keeps the BSB; this rule is about the Amharic edition only.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span: the whole verse, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'. Where OWB numbers a clause in the next verse (1 Pet 3:15-16 'gentleness and respect'), the row names OWB's verse. `self_rendered` rows are not quotations (a book title, reported speech, a popular misquote the author corrects, the author's own wording); each carries a `why`.
